0022600151.text: The Milwaukee Bucks (1-4, 14th in the East) host the Cleveland Cavaliers (3-2, 6th in the East) in the sixth game of Milwaukee's season, after losing their most recent game and posting a 1-2 home record. Cleveland is 3-0 at home and has been without Jaylon Tyson, who is out with an ankle sprain, while Meleek Thomas is day-to-day with a foot injury and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Cleveland won the last meeting 123-116 in Milwaukee on March 17, 2026, part of a 2025-26 season series in which the Bucks lost 1-3.
